question: If the English alphabet is given in reverse order, then what is the 12th letter to the right of O?
solution:
According to the question the English alphabet is given in reverse order:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cebf14239ec903658016e00f6f9fe4d8a1c26900fd9359b2bf5f687e8053a0a.png] 

Thus, if the English alphabet is given in reverse order, then C is the 12th letter to the right of O.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**According to the question the English alphabet is given in reverse order then the 12th letter to the right of O will be:

In the reverse order, all the alphabets will be at the opposite letter's position.

So, O will be at the position of its opposite letter i.e. L, and thus will be at the 12th position from left.

As asked is 12th letter to the right of O = 12 + 12 ⇒ 24th position 

As the 24th position is of 'X' according to the English alphabetic series, and in reverse order, the opposite letter is positioned which is 'C'.

Thus, 12th letter to the right of O will be C.
